User is interested in mosaic art, especially the significance of colors and how their cultural associations differ across world traditions. #mosaic-art #user-interests #culture

Across cultures, gold in mosaic and other art commonly symbolizes wealth, power, and divinity—seen in ancient Egyptian, Greek, and Roman art as well as Islamic and Christian traditions. #mosaic-art #culture

Blue is widely associated with the divine in art: in Hindu and Buddhist traditions it represents the infinite and celestial realms and the god Krishna; in Christian art it is linked to the Virgin Mary and symbolizes purity, humility, and trust. #mosaic-art #culture

Red carries varied cultural meanings: good luck and happiness in Chinese culture; life force, vitality, and fertility in many African cultures; purity, prosperity, and love in Hindu and Sikh traditions. #mosaic-art #culture

In South Asian art, yellow symbolizes knowledge, learning, and enlightenment in Hindu and Buddhist cultures; green signifies luck, good fortune, nature, growth, and fertility, and in Islamic traditions represents paradise and the afterlife. #mosaic-art #culture

Color use varies within regional traditions: North African Islamic mosaics favor blue and green, while Turkish and Iranian work favors red and yellow; Rajasthan's mirror mosaics favor bright orange, pink, and fuchsia. #mosaic-art #culture

Modern mosaic artists remain as deliberate about color as ancient artists, using it for emotion and meaning while experimenting with bold combinations and newer materials and techniques. #mosaic-art #culture

New events added at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics: skateboarding (street, park), sport climbing (speed, bouldering, lead), 3x3 basketball, karate, and surfing. Baseball and softball returned after a 13-year absence. #olympics #tokyo2020

3x3 basketball is played 3-on-3 on one half-court. Games last 10 minutes or end at 21 points; baskets inside the arc are 1 point, beyond the arc 2 points, free throws 1 point. Players foul out after six fouls, and substitutions happen only in dead-ball situations. #basketball #olympics

Olympic sport climbing at Tokyo 2020 had two scoring formats: speed climbing (timed race up a 15 m wall, two attempts, best time counts) and a combined score for bouldering plus lead climbing. #sport-climbing #olympics

Bouldering is climbing short walls (about 8-20 ft) without ropes, solving 4 problems with 4 minutes per attempt and points for fewest tries. Lead climbing is roped climbing on taller walls (80+ ft), scored by how high the climber gets within the time limit. #sport-climbing

Dominant nations in new Olympic sports: Japan and Brazil in skateboarding (Japan 3 of 4 golds at Tokyo 2020); Japan and Slovenia in sport climbing; USA and China in 3x3 basketball, though Latvia, Belgium and Serbia medaled in Tokyo; Japan in karate (3 of 8 events); Brazil in surfing (both golds at Tokyo 2020). #olympics

Paris 2024 Olympics additions/returns: breaking (breakdancing) debuts, while skateboarding, sport climbing, surfing and 3x3 basketball return; mixed relay triathlon also added (2 women + 2 men per team). #olympics #paris2024
